title: DecisionTrace
description: The primary artifact. A DAG of state -> action -> predicted successor -> evidence -> checks passed. Replayable offline, diffable across versions. Prose is rendered FROM this and is never the source of truth.

as_of.description: Bitemporal cut. State is reconstructed using only records with recorded_at <= as_of.

ledger_hash.description: Content hash of ledger state at as_of. Replay input.

determinism.description: Everything needed to re-execute byte-identically (R-05). Replay CI diffs traces on every commit.

artifact_hashes.description: Content hash per model artifact. Pinned, never a floating tag.

objective.description: Versioned, reviewed artifact with the same governance status as the invariant set (R-03).

form.description: Lexicographic preferred: hard constraints then ordered preferences. Scalarization buries tradeoffs in weights.

tradeoff_made.description: What was given up and what was bought, in the committed branch. Makes the objective visible per-decision, not only in config.

symbolic.description: Exact. Pure function of state and action; no seed needed.

residual.description: Learned correction against the symbolic baseline. Uncertainty is split and NEVER summed.

aleatoric.description: World noise. Irreducible; plan under it.

epistemic.description: Never seen this before. Reducible; route to a human.

conformal_interval.description: Distribution-free coverage. The auditable form of the confidence claim: an interval whose historical coverage rate anyone can re-derive from the replay corpus.

speculative.description: True past the calibrated horizon (R-01). A speculative node MAY NOT be cited in justification[] of a committed action - only as context. The trail renders its own uncertainty.

horizon_stop.description: decision_relevance = top-1 ranking flipped under bootstrap resampling. That is the real horizon.

evidence.description: Ledger record ids this node depends on. Provenance chases through to source.

shield.description: Checked OUTSIDE the network, on every candidate branch, before commit. A violation prunes; it is not argued with.

passed.description: Total: every invariant returns an explicit pass/fail. No silent not-applicable.

tail_source.description: Symbolic bounds preferred: tails are where learned data is thinnest and where the design leans hardest. A loose symbolic bound fails safe (R-03).

authority.description: The neural component is never an option here. bounded_autonomy requires the action class to be inside a proven envelope (P5).

envelope_id.description: Required for bounded_autonomy: the grant, traceable to the replay evidence that earned it.

justification.description: node_ids supporting the commit. MUST NOT contain any node with speculative=true.

rendered.description: Prose for humans, regenerated from this trace on read. A view, never a source. If prose and trace disagree, the trace wins by construction.
